resources.string: Have a friend’s link or QR code? Open New Chat and paste the link or scan the code to find them. If a name search comes up empty, ask them to share their profile.
Give someone your public profile link or show them your QR code so they can find you on White Noise. Keep your private sign-in key to yourself.
Want to respond to one message in a busy chat? Touch and hold it for replies and reactions. Try it on the example below.
Choose Reply to quote the message in your response, or choose an emoji to react.
Bring the right people into one conversation. Start a group from New Chat and choose who to invite. Your messages are end-to-end encrypted.
